cohort: 9159 patients who gave birth to a single fetus in cephalic presentation after prolonged pregnancy
finding: Morbidly obese patients with prolonged pregnancies had higher rates of induced labor, emergency cesarean section, and neonatal morbidity compared to those with normal BMI.
mod_finding: Obese patients undergoing prolonged pregnancy had significantly higher rates of induced labor and emergency cesarean delivery compared to those with normal BMI.
